title: Wajhulla Pay Masjid Mein Thalwaar Chalaee Hay
body:
Kulsoom O Rukiya Aur Zainab Ki Duhaee Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Sher-e-Khuda Tere Yatimon Ka Khuda Hafiz
Hasnain Ki Dushman Tho Pehlsai Hee Khudaee Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Shor Outha Falq-e-Chaharum Say Farishton Ka
Zarbat Koi Moula Kee, Thasveer Pay Aaee Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Sarkar-e-Risalat Nay Poocha Tha Yeh Jannat Mei
Khatoon-e-Qayamat Quen, Rothee Houee Aaee Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ikeeswee Ramzaan Ko Thaboot Outhaya Hay
Momin Nay Saf-e-Matam Ghar Ghar Mei Bichaee Hay
